title: Watch and answer
instruction: Watch two friends discuss camping. Explain what changes his mind, then choose your own kind of trip

video.title: The First Guy To Ever Go Camping

items.prompt: Why does one man suggest staying at home?
items.hint: Compare the camping equipment with what they already have at home
items.answer: He thinks camping gives them a less comfortable version of what they already have at home

items.prompt: What does his friend think they depend on too much?
items.hint: Listen for three things before disconnect
items.answer: His friend thinks they depend too much on their comforts, houses and devices

items.prompt: What finally makes camping sound nice to the hesitant man?
items.hint: Listen to the suggestion about nature and the stars
items.answer: The idea of disconnecting from their usual comforts, reconnecting with nature and looking at the stars makes it sound nice

items.prompt: Would you choose a camping trip or a comfortable hotel? Explain why and ask your teacher
items.hint: Compare comfort, nature and being away from your devices
items.answer: Example: I’d choose camping because I’d like to switch off and spend time outdoors. What would you choose?
